record.field: A corporation may file the paper Form T1178, General Index of Financial Information - Short, when its gross revenue AND its assets are each less than this amount (insurance corporations excluded). The GIFI statement reports the eligibility as information. Reference: CRA guide RC4088 (Rev. 23), "Using the GIFI-Short", and guide RC4089. Source: https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/forms-publications/publications/rc4088/general-index-financial-information-gifi.html

A corporation may file the paper Form T1178, General Index of Financial Information - Short, when its assets AND its gross revenue are each less than this amount (insurance corporations excluded). Compared with GIFI item 2599, Total assets. Reference: CRA guide RC4088 (Rev. 23), "Using the GIFI-Short", and guide RC4089. Source: https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/forms-publications/publications/rc4088/general-index-financial-information-gifi.html
